test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

She said to me, "Don't worry about me."

options.text: She told me don't worry about her.
She told me to not be worried about her.
She told me to not to worry about me.
She told me not to worry about her.

solution:
The correct answer is **"She told me not to worry about her.”** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of direct speech.
 
• Rules to change these types of questions:
 
 
• Said to will get replaced with told.
 
• **'Don't'** will get replaced with** 'not to'**
 
• Pronouns of the sentence i.e. 'me' will get replaced by 'her'.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is option 4.

 

Correct sentence: __*She told me not to worry about her.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

 

 

 
• Direct speech:A direct speech reports the precise words used by a speaker or writer.
 
• Indirect Speech: Indirect speech focuses more on the content of what someone said rather than their exact words.
